name: spec-flow
description: Release-centered Spec-Driven Development for Codex: approved strategy, versioned release artifacts, and evidence-gated execution and review.

interface.shortDescription: Strategy, versioned releases, and verified execution
interface.longDescription: Guide a project from constitution and applicable system design through an approved roadmap, explicit release specs, plans, tasks, verified phase execution, technical convergence, outcome review, and authorized branch integration. Legacy feature folders require migration.
defaultPrompt: Use Spec Flow to find the next authorized strategy or release step, verify its gate, and proceed within the approved scope.
